resources.string: BookMate
Internet Archive loans
Google sign-in (browser)

Google sign-in requires a supported browser. Open the book in your browser, sign in there, and continue borrowing and reading there. That browser sign-in does not connect BookMate’s in-app loan controls. To use those controls, sign in through Connect account with your Internet Archive email and password, if your account supports that method.
The provider page did not become visible within 25 seconds. Try Connect account again or Open in browser. If a loan request was sent, use Refresh to check its status before retrying.
Open Library timed out while checking the loan. No success was assumed. Try Refresh or Open in browser.
Open Library refused the loan-status request (HTTP 403). This may require verification on the provider website. Use Connect account or Open in browser.
Open Library is limiting requests (HTTP 429). Wait before trying Refresh again.
Open Library returned a server error while checking the loan. Try again later or use Open in browser.
The loan-status connection failed. Check whether Open Library opens in your phone’s browser, then try Refresh.

This will request the return of your current loan. BookMate will mark the book Finished only after verifying that the loan is no longer active.
